I respect that composure of yours, admire your vast learning and the devotion with which you serve the gods…”

units.source_zh: “你当不会拒绝。

paragraphs.source_en: Kariya Castle suddenly stirred into a flurry of activity. Odai was to take two ladies-in-waiting with her. In the end, Yuri, the daughter of the veteran retainer Hijikata Nuinosuke, and Ozasa, the daughter of Sugiyama Motoemon, were chosen. Yuri was eighteen, while Ozasa, like Odai, was only fourteen. Both had their eyebrows shaved and teeth blackened so that, should misfortune befall Odai, they could serve as her doubles.

units.source_en: Kariya Castle suddenly stirred into a flurry of activity.
units.source_zh: 刈谷城内突然忙碌了起来。

units.source_en: Odai was to take two ladies-in-waiting with her. In the end, Yuri, the daughter of the veteran retainer Hijikata Nuinosuke, and Ozasa, the daughter of Sugiyama Motoemon, were chosen.

paragraphs.source_zh: 刈谷城内突然忙碌了起来。於大要带两个侍女过去，最后选定了老臣土方缝殿助之女百合和杉山元右卫门之女小笹。百合年方十八，小笹和於大同龄，只十四。她们都削眉染齿，以便在於大遭遇不测时做她的替身。

paragraphs.source_en: “This is for Abe Ōkura, this for his younger brother Shirōbei, this for Ōkubo Shinjūrō, this for his younger brother Shinpachirō, and this one is for Ishikawa, this one for Sakai…”

units.source_en: “This is for Abe Ōkura, this for his younger brother Shirōbei, this for Ōkubo Shinjūrō, this for his younger brother Shinpachirō, and this one is for Ishikawa, this one for Sakai…”
units.source_zh: “这是给阿部大藏的，这是他弟弟四郎兵卫的，这是给大久保新十郎的，这是给他弟弟新八郎的，还有，这是给石川的，这是给酒井的⋯⋯”

paragraphs.source_en: Odai was still an innocent, cheerful girl. After carefully checking all the gifts her father was sending to the senior retainers of Okazaki, she smiled without a care and asked, “Will Mother come to see me at the Sakai residence?” She tilted her head, looking utterly guileless.

units.source_en: Odai was still an innocent, cheerful girl.
units.source_zh: 於大还只是一个天真开朗的少女。

units.source_en: After carefully checking all the gifts her father was sending to the senior retainers of Okazaki, she smiled without a care and asked, “Will Mother come to see me at the Sakai residence?”
units.source_zh: 她认真地检点完父亲送给冈崎重臣的礼物，便一脸无忧地笑问道：“母亲会到酒井府邸看我吗？”

units.source_en: She tilted her head, looking utterly guileless.

ja.t: は、どこまでもあどけなかった。

units.source_zh: 她歪着脑袋，显得那般天真无邪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 於大还只是一个天真开朗的少女。她认真地检点完父亲送给冈崎重臣的礼物，便一脸无忧地笑问道：“母亲会到酒井府邸看我吗？”她歪着脑袋，显得那般天真无邪。

paragraphs.source_en: Tadamasa had visited several times already, and Odai always greeted him with a smile. Yet Tadamasa knew both the antipathy his son-in-law Hirotada bore him and the designs of his son Nobumoto. His only hopes lay with Odai’s mother, Keyōin, and those senior Matsudaira retainers who sincerely believed that, caught between the Imagawa and the Oda, the Matsudaira and Mizuno clans would only destroy each other if they fought.

units.source_en: Tadamasa had visited several times already, and Odai always greeted him with a smile.
units.source_zh: 忠政已来过好几次，於大总是笑脸相迎。

units.source_en: Yet Tadamasa knew both the antipathy his son-in-law Hirotada bore him and the designs of his son Nobumoto.
units.source_zh: 但忠政既知女婿广忠对他的反感，也明白儿子信元的心思。

units.source_en: His only hopes lay with Odai’s mother, Keyōin, and those senior Matsudaira retainers who sincerely believed that, caught between the Imagawa and the Oda, the Matsudaira and Mizuno clans would only destroy each other if they fought.
units.source_zh: 唯一可以指望的，唯於大的母亲华阳院，还有那些发自内心地相信“夹在今川与织田之间，若松平氏和水野氏相斗，只会两败俱伤”的松平氏重臣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 忠政已来过好几次，於大总是笑脸相迎。但忠政既知女婿广忠对他的反感，也明白儿子信元的心思。唯一可以指望的，唯於大的母亲华阳院，还有那些发自内心地相信“夹在今川与织田之间，若松平氏和水野氏相斗，只会两败俱伤”的松平氏重臣。

paragraphs.source_en: The Matsudaira envoy returned to Okazaki, and before long the bridal procession carrying the dowry was to depart from Kariya Castle.

units.source_en: The Matsudaira envoy returned to Okazaki, and before long the bridal procession carrying the dowry was to depart from Kariya Castle.
units.source_zh: 松平使者返回冈崎，送嫁妆的队伍不久便要从刈谷城出发。

paragraphs.source_zh: 松平使者返回冈崎，送嫁妆的队伍不久便要从刈谷城出发。

paragraphs.source_en: The twenty-fourth day of the first month in the tenth year of Tenbun. Rather than Odai, who was about to leave home as a bride, it was her elder brother Nobumoto who seemed more flustered and restless.

units.source_en: The twenty-fourth day of the first month in the tenth year of Tenbun.
units.source_zh: 天文十年正月二十四。

units.source_en: Rather than Odai, who was about to leave home as a bride, it was her elder brother Nobumoto who seemed more flustered and restless.
units.source_zh: 较之即将出阁的於大，兄长信元反而更为慌张，更为坐立不安。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天文十年正月二十四。较之即将出阁的於大，兄长信元反而更为慌张，更为坐立不安。

paragraphs.source_en: “Father, your daughter is leaving.”

units.source_en: “Father, your daughter is leaving.”
units.source_zh: “父亲，女儿走了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “父亲，女儿走了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. Take good care of yourself.”

units.source_en: “Yes. Take good care of yourself.”
units.source_zh: “嗯，自己多保重。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “嗯，自己多保重。”

paragraphs.source_en: “You too, Father.”

units.source_en: “You too, Father.”
units.source_zh: “父亲您也多保重。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “父亲您也多保重。”

paragraphs.source_en: Odai took leave of each member of her family. Just as she was about to step into the palanquin waiting on the entrance stairs, she turned and raised her limpid eyes, gazing steadily at the retainers who had come to see her off. Her large, dewy eyes held no complicated emotions, only the innocent radiance unique to a girl of her age. The gleam of her gold-embroidered sash showed faintly beneath her outer robe, lending Odai a delicate, touching beauty.

units.source_en: Odai took leave of each member of her family.
units.source_zh: 於大一一辞别家人。

units.source_en: Just as she was about to step into the palanquin waiting on the entrance stairs, she turned and raised her limpid eyes, gazing steadily at the retainers who had come to see her off.

units.source_en: Her large, dewy eyes held no complicated emotions, only the innocent radiance unique to a girl of her age.

paragraphs.source_zh: 於大一一辞别家人。当她快要迈进大门台阶上的轿子时，回过头来，抬起一双清澈如水的眸子，目不转睛地望着前来送行的家臣。她那双水汪汪的大眼里，没有复杂的情感，只有她那个年纪独有的天真烂漫。绣金衣带的光芒在罩衫下隐约可见，把於大衬托得楚楚动人。

paragraphs.source_en: The procession passed through the gate of the third enclosure, crossed the grove of cherry trees beside the senior retainers’ residences, and reached the outer gate. The families of the retainers had already crowded before the gate, eager to seize this chance to behold their lord’s beloved daughter.

units.source_en: The procession passed through the gate of the third enclosure, crossed the grove of cherry trees beside the senior retainers’ residences, and reached the outer gate.

paragraphs.source_en: “What? What in the world is going on?” Everyone stared at one another in bewilderment. Not only were the palanquin doors tightly shut, but the bridal procession had somehow multiplied into three separate parties. Three identical palanquins, identically dressed attendants—the three parties were indistinguishable.

paragraphs.source_en: Leading the first party was Ozasa’s father, Sugiyama Motoemon. Naturally, the people assumed this must be Odai’s palanquin and watched until the party receded into the distance. They were about to disperse when another cry rang out and the second party approached. This time the leader was Makita Kinosuke. In both lineage and martial skill, he was in no way inferior to Sugiyama Motoemon, and he too was a senior Mizuno retainer.

paragraphs.source_en: “This must be a precaution against mishap along the road. paragraphs.source_en: The onlookers’ faces changed. Never before had they seen so strange a bridal procession, and they could not help feeling anxious and alarmed.

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, Hatarō was concealed in a little thatched hut beside the Aizuma River near Chirifu, a league and a half north of Kariya Castle, quietly awaiting word from Nobumoto.

paragraphs.source_zh: 波太郎此时正藏身于刈谷城北一里半、靠近池鲤鲋的逢妻川边的小茅屋中，静待信元的消息。

paragraphs.source_en: The place was commonly called Yatsuhashi. Few now remember its name, but in The Tales of Ise it was celebrated as a place for viewing rabbit-ear irises, and it was also a renowned district of waterways. Waterways intersected throughout the vicinity, and little bridges spread like a spider’s web.

paragraphs.source_en: Humming a tune, a farmer with a spade over his shoulder came to the hut where Hatarō was hiding. “I have been sent by Lord Nobumoto with a message.”
